deed-intake.title: Deed intake
deed-intake.summary: Reads the facts for the deed from the documents

questions.agreement: Upload the signed sale agreement. Then continue.
questions.missing: The documents don't mention {label}. What is it? Leave empty if you don't know yet.
questions.title_deed: Upload the seller's title deed, the earlier deed by which the seller acquired the property. If it is not at hand, say there is none.
questions.certificates: Upload the certificates: the energy performance certificate and the soil certificate. If they are not at hand, say there are none.

checks.a_seller: There is at least one seller
checks.a_buyer: There is at least one buyer
checks.deposit_within_price: The advance or guarantee is within the price
checks.deed_after_agreement: The deed's deadline falls after the agreement was signed
checks.conditions_before_deed: Every suspensive condition's term falls before the deed's deadline
